warranty.label: Warranty
warranty.description: Manufacturer's warranty as per the warranty card, on top of the statutory warranty.

statutory.label: Statutory warranty
statutory.description: 2 years by law from purchase, even without a manufacturer's warranty.

maintenance.label: Maintenance
maintenance.description: Recurring appointments such as vehicle inspection, servicing or heating maintenance.

vignette.label: Vignette
vignette.description: Motorway vignette: annual, 2-month or 10-day vignette. We'll remind you before it expires.

firstYear.title: If there's a defect: go to the seller first
firstYear.body: Contact {{store}}. Until {{proofUntil}}, the seller has to prove that the defect wasn't already there at purchase.

statutory.title: If there's a defect: go to the seller
statutory.body: The statutory warranty with {{store}} is valid until {{statutoryUntil}}. Since {{proofUntil}}, you have to prove that the defect was already there at purchase.
statutory.warrantyAlternative: Alternatively, the warranty from {{brand}} until {{warrantyUntil}} can help, often without this proof.

claim.grace: If the defect appeared by {{statutoryUntil}}, you can still claim it with the seller until {{claimUntil}}, in court if necessary.

manufacturer.title: If there's a defect: go to the manufacturer
manufacturer.body: The statutory warranty has expired. Use the warranty from {{brand}} until {{warrantyUntil}}.

expired.title: Deadlines expired
expired.body: The statutory warranty and the warranty have expired. Ask the seller or manufacturer about a goodwill gesture or a repair.

apiError.deviceLimit: You reached the device limit of your plan. Choose a bigger plan under Plans.
